rows.text: takes the top three bits of byte `[rcx + 3]`: when they are 1 it calls `003DA860([rcx + 0xB8] + 0x30, null, xmm1, xmm1)` with 1.0 (`01CEBBA8`) as both stack arguments; when they are 3 it calls `003DA890(rbx + 0x60, rbx + 0x50)` with `rbx = [rcx + 0xB8]` and `xmm1` as the third (float) argument, then stores 1 to byte `[rbx + 0xDF]`; any other value returns without a call
stores 0 to dword `[0209A3E0 + sign-extended ecx * 8]` and tail-jumps to `003278D0`

when `edx` is positive (signed), walks `edx` 8-byte entries of `0209A3E0` from the sign-extended index `ecx`, storing 0 to each entry's first dword and calling `003278D0` after each store; when `edx` is zero or negative it returns at once
returns the sign-extended word `+0x8A` of `[[rcx + 0xC0] + 0x138]`, or -1 when `[rcx + 0xC0]` or its `+0x138` pointer is null
returns the sign-extended word `+0x86` of `[[rcx + 0xC0] + 0x138]`, or -1 when `[rcx + 0xC0]` or its `+0x138` pointer is null

pops a value through `VMValueStack_PopInt32CoerceFloat32(r9)`, resolves it with `PartyRoster_GetActorBySlotOrCurrentFocus`, and when the actor is non-null reads its value through the getter that returns the signed word `+0x86` of `[[actor + 0xC0] + 0x138]` (-1 when either pointer is null); it tail-jumps `VMResult_WriteInt32(rcx, value)` with the value kept only when non-negative, else 0 (also 0 when there is no actor)

pops a value through `VMValueStack_PopInt32CoerceFloat32(r9)`, resolves it with `PartyRoster_GetActorBySlotOrCurrentFocus`, and when the actor is non-null reads its value through the getter that returns the signed word `+0x8A` of `[[actor + 0xC0] + 0x138]` (-1 when either pointer is null); it tail-jumps `VMResult_WriteInt32(rcx, value)` with the value kept only when non-negative, else 0 (also 0 when there is no actor)
when `ecx` is negative it tail-jumps `0026E150(0, 0x20)`; otherwise it tail-jumps `0026E130(ecx)`
